2607.28126.title: ConMem: Contribution-Aware Memory for Long-Horizon Manufacturing Inspection Logs
2607.28126.paper_summary: Long-horizon steel-equipment inspection requires reasoning over heterogeneous records accumulated across repeated inspection cycles. Existing retrieval-augmented generation systems treat historical logs as a static corpus and retain records without estimating their diagnostic value, failing to report early risk. To this end, we propose ConMem, a contribution-aware memory framework for LLM-assisted equipment inspection, supporting a human-in-the-loop early-risk screening system. Specifically, our ConMem first segments inspection logs into functional evidence units, then estimates each memory unit's contribution to downstream diagnosis through a Shapley-style estimation, and finally retains high-value evidence under a constrained memory budget. In experiments, we evaluate ConMem on real-world dataset and ConMem achieves 76.0% QA accuracy, exceeding the strongest directly comparable baseline. Relative to the naive 8K-context LLM baselines, it reduces the average number of input tokens by 88.2% and response time by 86.6%. Ablation studies also show that the functional-role-aware segmentation and contribution-based valuation are helping prioritize weak degradation signals for targeted field inspection. Practical deployments further confirm that ConMem retains the weak early signal across three inspection cycles, providing an early-stage seal-wear alert targeted for on-site inspectors.
2607.28126.paper_summary_zh: 長期鋼鐵設備檢查需要對在重複檢查周期中累積的異質記錄進行推理。現有的檢索增強生成系統將歷史日誌視為靜態語料庫，並保留記錄而不評估其診斷價值，未能及早報告風險。為此，我們提出了ConMem，一個關注貢獻的記憶框架，用於LLM輔助的設備檢查，支持人機協作的早期風險篩查系統。具體而言，我們的ConMem首先將檢查日誌分段為功能證據單元，然後通過Shapley風格的估計來評估每個記憶單元對下游診斷的貢獻，最後在受限的記憶預算下保留高價值證據。在實驗中，我們在真實世界數據集上評估了ConMem，ConMem達到了76.0%的QA準確率，超過了最強的直接可比基準。相對於天真的8K上下文LLM基準，它將平均輸入標記數減少了88.2%，回應時間減少了86.6%。消融研究還顯示，功能角色意識的分段和基於貢獻的評價有助於優先考慮針對性現場檢查的弱退化信號。實際部署進一步確認，ConMem在三個檢查周期中保留了弱的早期信號，為現場檢查員提供了針對性的早期密封磨損警報。
